context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin dashboard fully tested and working. Key features: 1) Admin auth via POST /api/admin/login with password from .env, returns JWT token (24h expiry), 2) All /api/admin/* routes protected by JWT, 3) Settings stored in MongoDB 'settings' collection, secrets masked in GET response, 4) Masked secret values (***) are NOT overwritten on POST, 5) Services read settings from DB first, fallback to .env. Fixed critical bug where MongoDB database objects were incorrectly used in boolean context. Admin password: changeme123. Backend URL: https://car-buyback-1.preview.emergentagent.com

mocked_apis.autobiz_service.py: Vehicle identification and quotation fully mocked

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In hubspot_service.py and webhook_service.py, the code used 'if _db:' to check if database was set. However, MongoDB database objects (AsyncIOMotorDatabase) do not implement __bool__ method and raise NotImplementedError when used in boolean context.
reproduction_steps: 1. Call POST /api/leads/save with valid lead data
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Changed 'if _db:' to 'if _db is not None:' in both hubspot_service.py and webhook_service.py. This is the correct way to check if a MongoDB database object has been set.
